The case is decided as **auto-fix**, handed to the coder.

The investigator found the cause in `OrderService.OrderApi.GetOrderTotal` (`src/OrderService/Api/OrderTotal.cs`, line 18). Order 1003 carries the retired discount code SUMMER25, which isn't in the `DiscountRates` table, so the indexer throws `KeyNotFoundException` instead of giving no discount. The investigator rated its confidence high and said the area is code. That matches the runbook row "a crash in this method's code, its cause certain, e.g. a `KeyNotFoundException` for a retired discount code", which gives auto-fix to the coder.

The fix should give no discount for an unknown code, so the total equals the subtotal. Totals for WELCOME10, VIP20 and no-code orders must not change.

I can't brief the coder directly, because it isn't among the agents I'm permitted to ask. The coder receives the case through the auto-fix decision and the run history recorded above. The investigator didn't run the test suite, so the fix will need to be checked when the coder reports back.
